summary: RemedialFlow Phase 5 (TrustMark rejection), Phase 8 (Evidence Pack export) and Weekly Payments verified end-to-end against the public preview URL. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed (new file /app/backend/tests/test_p5_p6_p8_payments.py). TrustMark reject correctly flips approved -> rejected with rejection_source='trustmark', pushes reopen_history in Mongo, sends 'rejected_trustmark' notification with the review note, reopens the project (completed->in_progress), does NOT remove or duplicate the earlier earning, and 400s on non-approved NC / 403s on installer. Evidence Pack ZIP is correctly named '<REF>_Evidence_Pack.zip', contains one PDF per NC named 'NC-01_<Short_Title>.pdf', each PDF with 'Original TrustMark observation', 'Required remedial work', 'before'/'after' section headings and the approval status line 'INTERNALLY APPROVED (AI|employee/admin) <YYYY-MM-DD>' (or NOT YET INTERNALLY APPROVED line); mp4 uploaded via imageio_ffmpeg correctly ends up under Videos/NC-01_<Title>.mp4; tampered sig and expired exp both return 403; P419977 Evidence Pack also exports successfully (read-only). Payments: GET /api/admin/payments groups by installer_id + Monday-ISO week with unpaid/paid/jobs[], 403 for employee/installer; POST /api/admin/payments/mark-paid flips the week's 'earned' rows to 'paid' and /api/earnings reflects the change. Frontend code review verified that every required testID is present (jobs-section-{action,new,active,completed}, trustmark-reject-{NC}, photo-viewer, photo-viewer-counter, photo-viewer-close, photo-viewer-info, photo-viewer-meta, camera-flash-button, camera-zoom-button, camera-focus-ring, pay-group-<Name>-<week>, pay-week-...). Live UI browser automation partially completed - admin project list route /projects renders Unmatched Route page (needs confirmation of the correct admin projects route e.g. /admin/projects) and Expo networkidle navigation often times out due to persistent websocket; backend-driven proof + code review is comprehensive. Minor model issue found: NC pydantic model (core.py:103) uses extra='ignore' and does NOT declare `reopen_history`, so the field is correctly $pushed to Mongo but filtered on serialisation - audit trail confirms it's stored. Also console warn: Image.style.resizeMode is deprecated - use props.resizeMode.

minor.issue: NC objects omit reopen_history. core.py:103 declares the NC pydantic model with extra='ignore' and no reopen_history field, so the server's $push to reopen_history (server.py:740) survives in Mongo but is dropped by model_dump() in project_detail (server.py:467-476). The frontend therefore cannot show the audit of prior approvals via /projects. Add `reopen_history: List[dict] = []` to NC (and the matching previous_approved_at/by sub-fields) so the UI can render the TrustMark reopen history.

integration_issues.issue: Navigating to /projects renders the 'Unmatched Route' page. Confirm the correct Expo Router path for the staff/admin project list (likely /admin/projects or similar) and update any deep-link docs/tests.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Grep for `resizeMode:` inside StyleSheet.create blocks and move those to the component's props. Non-blocking but noisy on every screen load.

action_items: Add `reopen_history: List[dict] = []` to NC in /app/backend/core.py so the Phase 5 reopen audit (previous_approved_at/by, source, note) is visible via GET /api/projects/{pid}. Current behaviour: stored in Mongo but filtered by extra='ignore' during Pydantic serialisation.

Confirm/document the admin & staff project-list route. /projects currently renders 'Unmatched Route' - update the frontend route or the `router.push` targets in jobs.tsx/dashboard so staff can reach the project list used for TrustMark reject + Evidence Pack flows.
Move Image resizeMode out of StyleSheet styles into the Image component's resizeMode prop to silence the recurring deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:729 - the 400 check `if body.action == 'trustmark_reject' and nc.status != 'approved'` is correct; confirmed via test_12 that a second trustmark_reject on an already-rejected NC returns 400.
server.py:739-741 - $push of reopen_history includes previous_approved_at + previous_approved_by captured from the in-memory NC *before* the $set; good - no race.

evidence_pack.py:41-56 - repeated_hashes correctly excludes images appearing on 2+ NCs (logos/headers) from the 'before' section via drop_repeated; select_photos picks the top 6 by sharpness/lighting with dHash<=6 near-dup rejection.
server.py:982-986 - approval status line format matches spec exactly ('INTERNALLY APPROVED (AI|employee/admin) <YYYY-MM-DD>' or 'NOT YET INTERNALLY APPROVED - current status: <status>').
server.py:889 - /api/admin/payments returns groups sorted so unpaid-first weeks come first (unpaid==0 sort key False first); matches spec intent.
settle_earnings is idempotent - test_13 confirms no duplicate earning on reject+re-approve.

success_rate.frontend: code-review verified (all required testIDs present); live UI partially verified due to Expo networkidle timeouts and the unmatched /projects route

It leaves one TEST-TM-* project in the DB with NC-01 approved and NC-02 approved, and that week's installer-A earnings paid. If re-approving test_13 fails because an earning now shows status=paid rather than earned, the no-duplicate assertion still holds (we count rows, not status). Admin's /projects frontend route is unmatched - try /admin/projects or inspect app/_layout.tsx for the staff list route.
rca_of_issue: Minor NC pydantic model omission: core.py:103 declares NC with ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and lists every status/approval field but does NOT declare `reopen_history`. Server pushes to that key correctly (server.py:740) and it IS persisted in Mongo, however `NC.from_mongo(doc)` drops the key when parsing and subsequently `.model_dump()` omits it. Impact: the installer NC card can still show the latest `review_note` (which is a declared field), but the staff/admin UI cannot render the full previous_approved_at/by history. Fix: add `reopen_history: List[dict] = []` to NC in core.py.
